message:
The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and instead of scrambling around for flashlights and phone chargers like I usually do, I felt a little proud of myself. I had my trusty lanterns ready, power banks all charged up, and even a few snacks in case we needed a mini feast. 

It was kind of nice, actually—just us gathered in the living room, sharing stories by lantern light, instead of being glued to screens. I realized that being prepared really does make a difference in those unexpected moments.

Have you ever found yourself finally being the prepared one? What’s your go-to tip for weathering a power outage? 🌟
